subject: POC extension request — phased milestone billing and discount options
messages:
From: Hugo Tran <hugo@loxley.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@loxley.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 4-week extension for POC & billing clarification

Sergio —

Quick note from our side: our internal data pipeline team hit an unexpected dependency delay, so we won't be able to complete our integration tests in the original 8-week POC window. Can we get a 4-week extension on the POC to finish the integration and complete the evaluation?

Two asks from procurement: 1) confirm whether the extension can be billed as a time-boxed addendum (line-item for weeks) or if you prefer converting unused days into credits; 2) any possibility of a one-time concession on rate given the delay (we're mid-eval and still very interested).

I've attached the SOW with a redline that indicates the integration milestone dates.

Thanks —
Hugo
Hugo Tran
Head of ML Ops, Loxley Systems
Attachments: Loxley_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Hugo Tran <hugo@loxley.ai>
Cc: procurement@loxley.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 4-week extension for POC & billing clarification

Hi Hugo —

Thanks for the heads up and the SOW — totally understand the situation. We can support an extension; two pragmatic paths we typically offer:

- Option A — Credit convert: convert up to 30 unused days into platform credits you can spend on additional inference hours or a future pilot. No change to rate.
- Option B — Time-boxed extension: extend the POC by 6 weeks (we recommend 6 vs 4 to give a buffer). For this we can offer a one-time concession on the added weeks.

Before I lock numbers I need quick internal approval; I'll propose a 12% concession on the extension weeks with a milestone acceptance schedule (3 milestones: integration smoke tests, end-to-end perf run, final evaluation signoff). Onboarding support (2 sessions) included. If procurement prefers credits instead, we can convert remaining days at the original rate into a credit bucket that expires in 6 months.

I'll put a short term sheet together and loop in our CS lead for success milestones. Quick question: does Loxley need the extension priced as a separate invoice line (preferred by many procurement teams)?

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0189
Attachments: extension_term_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, finance@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 4-week extension for POC & billing clarification

Sergio —

Agree with your approach. A couple of guardrails from revenue:
1) Concessions <= 12% can be approved at AE + Manager level; anything >15% needs Director/Finance signoff.
2) If we do credits, ensure we cap the credit-dollar equivalent and set a 6-month expiry.
3) If procurement requires a separate invoice line, ops prefers a short amendment (no longer than one page) showing line items: weeks, rate, discount, tax.

I recommend offering the 6-week extension with 12% concession + onboarding. That buys them runway and keeps the economics intact. Monica — can you confirm bandwidth for the two onboarding sessions and the weekly health check cadence?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 4-week extension for POC & billing clarification

Happy to support. Proposed CS deliverables if we go the 6-week path:
- Kickoff onboarding session (90m) within 48 hours of amendment signature.
- Integration verification session (1hr) at week 2.
- Performance tuning session (1hr) at week 4.
- Final review + acceptance checklist at week 6.
- Weekly 30m health checks (email recap) to track progress against three milestones.

I'll block tentative slots on the calendar once Sergio confirms the amendment. No extra charge for this for the extension period.

-Monica
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Hugo Tran <hugo@loxley.ai>
Cc: procurement@loxley.ai, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 4-week extension for POC & billing clarification

Hugo —

Thanks for the quick reply. To make this concrete, here's our proposed amendment (summary):

- Extension: 6 additional weeks added to current POC term (effective on execution).
- Pricing: Standard POC rate applies to extension weeks. One-time concession: 12% discount applied to the total amount for the 6 weeks.
- Milestones (acceptance triggers):
  1) Integration smoke tests complete (week 2) — pass/fail signoff by Loxley eng lead.
  2) End-to-end performance run (week 4) — throughput & latency targets measured.
  3) Final evaluation signoff (week 6) — formal acceptance.
- CS Support: 2 onboarding/tuning sessions + weekly 30m health checks during the extension (no additional fee).
- Billing: We can issue a separate invoice line for the extension (preferred) or convert unused days into credits if that's procurement's preference.

Attached is a 1-page amendment + term sheet and a DocuSign link to sign once you confirm. If procurement needs a PO/invoice line, let me know the exact PO number and billing contact and we'll generate it right away.

Next steps: please confirm (A) accept extension with 12% concession and milestone schedule, or (B) request credit conversion and we will respond with the credit conversion table.

Link: https://docusign.com/send/abc123-extension

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Hugo Tran <hugo@loxley.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@loxley.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 4-week extension for POC & billing clarification

Sergio / team —

We appreciate the flexibility. We accept the 6-week extension with the 12% concession and the milestone schedule you outlined. Procurement asked for two items before signing:
1) a short invoice line item (we will issue a PO once we receive it)
2) the DocuSign amendment so our legal/procurement can review and sign.

I'll have procurement send the PO number to you by EOD Monday once they receive the invoice. Please proceed with the amendment and send the invoice. We'll route DocuSign through procurement and legal.

Thanks,
Hugo
